adc_digital.note: SAR logic + pin decoding, LibreLane macro under the top pins

bias_gen.note: 1 uA reference; pbias/nbias to all analog blocks

ptat_out.note: PTAT branch, next to the bandgap's vgp

bandgap_core.note: incl. OTA, PNP 3x3 array, R1/R2 chains, startup

vref_filt.note: 1 MOhm + 3.9 pF, directly under the bandgap that feeds it

reserve_right.note: spare, next to the DAC: e.g. a larger reservoir cap

comparator.note: directly above the DAC: short, shielded vtop

cap_dac.note: 16x16 MIM units + dummy ring (18x18 at 4 um pitch); no met4 stripe

dac_sw.note: 9 bottom-plate switch cells, one under each column group

vref_buf.note: incl. 5.4 pF reservoir cap; vref to dac_sw is short

vref_sel.note: logic + TG; sits on the ua[1] pin (x = 132.9)

inmux.note: VIN from ua[0] (x = 152.3) up the right edge
